```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import * as ToastPrimitives from "@radix-ui/react-toast";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";

// Rótulos PT-BR padrão (ADR-016). Os padrões do Radix são em inglês
// ("Notification", "Notifications ({hotkey})") e seriam lidos pelo leitor de tela.
const TOAST_LABEL = "Notificação";
const TOAST_VIEWPORT_LABEL = "Notificações ({hotkey})";
const TOAST_CLOSE_LABEL = "Fechar notificação";

const ToastProvider = ({
  label = TOAST_LABEL,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Provider>) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Provider label={label} {...props} />
);
ToastProvider.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Provider.displayName;

const ToastViewport = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Viewport>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Viewport>
>(({ className, label = TOAST_VIEWPORT_LABEL, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Viewport
    ref={ref}
    label={label}
    className={cn(
      "fixed top-0 right-0 z-[100] flex max-h-screen w-full flex-col gap-2 p-4 sm:top-4 sm:right-4 md:max-w-[420px]",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
ToastViewport.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Viewport.displayName;

const toastVariants = cva(
  "group pointer-events-auto relative flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 overflow-hidden rounded-[12px] border border-border bg-card p-4 text-card-foreground shadow-elevation-2 font-sans transition-all data-[swipe=cancel]:translate-x-0 data-[swipe=end]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-end-x)] data-[swipe=move]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-move-x)] data-[swipe=move]:transition-none data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[swipe=end]:animate-out",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "border-border bg-card text-card-foreground",
        success:
          "border-none bg-success-emphasis text-success-emphasis-foreground px-5 py-4 [&_[toast-close]]:text-success-emphasis-foreground [&_[toast-close]]:hover:bg-success-emphasis-foreground/10",
        warning: "border-warning/40 bg-warning-surface text-foreground",
        destructive: "border-destructive/40 bg-destructive-surface text-destructive",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
);

const Toast = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root> &
    VariantProps<typeof toastVariants>
>(({ className, variant, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Root
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(toastVariants({ variant }), className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
Toast.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Root.displayName;

const ToastAction = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Action>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Action>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Action
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "inline-flex h-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-transparent px-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
ToastAction.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Action.displayName;

const ToastClose = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Close>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Close>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Close
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "-m-2 inline-flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring",
      className
    )}
    toast-close=""
    aria-label={TOAST_CLOSE_LABEL}
    {...props}
  >
    <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
  </ToastPrimitives.Close>
));
ToastClose.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Close.displayName;

const ToastTitle = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Title>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Title>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Title
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("text-base font-bold leading-tight", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
ToastTitle.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Title.displayName;

const ToastDescription = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Description>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Description>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Description
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("text-sm font-normal leading-[1.4] opacity-95", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
ToastDescription.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Description.displayName;

type ToastProps = React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Toast>;

type ToastActionElement = React.ReactElement<typeof ToastAction>;

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  action?: ToastActionElement;
};

const TOAST_LIMIT = 3;
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 5000;

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const;

let count = 0;
const genId = () => `${count++}`;

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;

type Action =
  | { type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]; toast: ToasterToast }
  | { type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]; toast: Partial<ToasterToast> }
  | { type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]; toastId?: ToasterToast["id"] }
  | { type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]; toastId?: ToasterToast["id"] };

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[];
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) return;
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    dispatch({ type: "REMOVE_TOAST", toastId });
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);
  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
};

const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return { toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT) };
    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      };
    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action;
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((t) => addToRemoveQueue(t.id));
      }
      return { toasts: state.toasts.map((t) => (t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined ? { ...t, open: false } : t)) };
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      return { toasts: action.toastId === undefined ? [] : state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId) };
  }
};

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener(memoryState));
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">;

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId();
  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({ type: "UPDATE_TOAST", toast: { ...props, id } });
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id });

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss();
      },
    },
  });

  return { id, dismiss, update };
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState);
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
      if (index > -1) listeners.splice(index, 1);
    };
  }, []);

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  };
}

export interface ToasterProps {
  /** Prefixo anunciado pelo leitor de tela em cada aviso. Padrão: "Notificação". */
  label?: string;
  /** Nome da região de avisos; `{hotkey}` vira o atalho (F8). Padrão: "Notificações ({hotkey})". */
  viewportLabel?: string;
  /** Nome acessível do botão de fechar. Padrão: "Fechar notificação". */
  closeLabel?: string;
}

function Toaster({
  label = TOAST_LABEL,
  viewportLabel = TOAST_VIEWPORT_LABEL,
  closeLabel = TOAST_CLOSE_LABEL,
}: ToasterProps = {}) {
  const { toasts } = useToast();

  return (
    <ToastProvider label={label}>
      {toasts.map(({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) => (
        <Toast key={id} {...props}>
          <div className="grid gap-1">
            {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
            {description && (
              <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>
            )}
          </div>
          {action}
          <ToastClose aria-label={closeLabel} />
        </Toast>
      ))}
      <ToastViewport label={viewportLabel} />
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

export {
  ToastProvider,
  ToastViewport,
  Toast,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastClose,
  ToastAction,
  Toaster,
  useToast,
};
```

### Aviso (`alert`) — `src/components/alert.tsx` — slug: aviso

Desc: Mensagem de feedback em linha, com ícone automático por variante. Só destructive interrompe o leitor de tela (role=alert); as demais usam role=status.

Variantes: variant: default · success · warning · destructive · announce: assertive (role=alert) · polite (role=status) · off (sem região viva) — padrão: destructive → assertive, demais → polite; role explícito tem precedência · AlertTitle as: div (padrão) · p · h1–h6

Uso:
```tsx
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from "@semec/ds/react";

<Alert variant="warning">
  <AlertTitle>Carnê indisponível</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>O sistema volta às 14h.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>

// Erro que pede ação imediata: role=alert automático
<Alert variant="destructive">
  <AlertTitle>Pagamento recusado</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>Confira os dados do cartão.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>

// Aviso estático, presente desde o carregamento: sem região viva
<Alert announce="off">
  <AlertTitle as="h2">Como funciona</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>O protocolo é analisado em até 5 dias úteis.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>
```

Prompt:
```text
Use o componente `Alert` (Aviso) importado de `@semec/ds/react`; não reimplemente, não copie o código-fonte e não recrie o estilo com outras classes. Mensagem de feedback em linha, com ícone automático por variante. Só destructive interrompe o leitor de tela (role=alert); as demais usam role=status. API e variantes: variant: default · success · warning · destructive · announce: assertive (role=alert) · polite (role=status) · off (sem região viva) — padrão: destructive → assertive, demais → polite; role explícito tem precedência · AlertTitle as: div (padrão) · p · h1–h6. Parta do exemplo de uso do componente, com rótulos em PT-BR e tokens do tokens.css (sem hex). Se faltar alguma capacidade, componha com outros componentes do kit ou proponha a mudança por issue no repositório do design system.
```

Fonte:
```tsx
import * as React from "react";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Info } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";
import type { HeadingTag } from "./heading";

const alertVariants = cva(
  "relative w-full rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm [&>svg]:absolute [&>svg]:left-4 [&>svg]:top-4 [&>svg]:h-4 [&>svg]:w-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "border-info/40 bg-info-surface text-foreground [&>svg]:text-info",
        success:
          "border-success/40 bg-success-surface text-foreground [&>svg]:text-success",
        warning:
          "border-warning/40 bg-warning-surface text-foreground [&>svg]:text-warning",
        destructive:
          "border-destructive/40 bg-destructive-surface text-foreground [&>svg]:text-destructive",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
);

type AlertVariant = NonNullable<VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>["variant"]>;

const iconMap: Record<AlertVariant, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
  default: Info,
  success: CheckCircle2,
  warning: AlertTriangle,
  destructive: AlertCircle,
};

/**
 * Como o aviso é anunciado por leitor de tela:
 * - `assertive`: `role="alert"` (interrompe a leitura; só para erro que pede ação imediata);
 * - `polite`: `role="status"` (lido na próxima pausa);
 * - `off`: sem região viva (aviso estático, já presente ao carregar a página).
 */
export type AlertAnnounce = "assertive" | "polite" | "off";

/**
 * Padrão por variante: só `destructive` interrompe. `warning` é `polite` porque
 * avisos (indisponibilidade, prazo) raramente exigem ação imediata e vários
 * `role="alert"` na mesma tela geram anúncios assertivos em excesso (AUD-22).
 */
const announceByVariant: Record<AlertVariant, AlertAnnounce> = {
  default: "polite",
  success: "polite",
  warning: "polite",
  destructive: "assertive",
};

const roleByAnnounce: Record<AlertAnnounce, "alert" | "status" | undefined> = {
  assertive: "alert",
  polite: "status",
  off: undefined,
};

export interface AlertProps
  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof alertVariants> {
  /**
   * Sobrescreve o anúncio padrão da variante (`destructive` → `assertive`;
   * demais → `polite`). Uma prop `role` explícita tem precedência.
   */
  announce?: AlertAnnounce;
}

const Alert = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AlertProps>(
  ({ className, variant = "default", announce, role, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    const resolvedVariant: AlertVariant = variant ?? "default";
    const Icon = iconMap[resolvedVariant];
    const resolvedRole =
      role ?? roleByAnnounce[announce ?? announceByVariant[resolvedVariant]];
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role={resolvedRole}
        className={cn(alertVariants({ variant }), "pl-10", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <Icon className="absolute left-4 top-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  }
);
Alert.displayName = "Alert";

export interface AlertTitleProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement> {
  /**
   * Elemento do título. Padrão: `div` — o título do aviso é um rótulo, não
   * uma seção da página, e o antigo `<h5>` fixo quebrava a ordem dos títulos
   * (`heading-order`). Passe `h2`–`h6` quando o aviso abrir uma seção.
   */
  as?: HeadingTag;
}

const AlertTitle = React.forwardRef<HTMLHeadingElement, AlertTitleProps>(
  ({ className, as: Tag = "div", ...props }, ref) => (
    <Tag
      ref={ref}
      className={cn("mb-1 font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
);
AlertTitle.displayName = "AlertTitle";

const AlertDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "text-sm [&_p]:leading-relaxed [&_ul]:mt-2 [&_ul]:list-disc [&_ul]:list-inside [&_ul]:space-y-1.5 [&_ol]:mt-2 [&_ol]:list-decimal [&_ol]:list-inside [&_ol]:space-y-1.5",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertDescription.displayName = "AlertDescription";

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription };
```

### Diálogo de alerta (`alert-dialog`) — `src/components/alert-dialog.tsx` — slug: dialogo-de-alerta

Desc: Confirmação perigosa. Força decisão (ação/cancelar) antes de prosseguir: role="alertdialog", sempre modal, não fecha por clique fora e abre com o foco no Cancelar.

Variantes: composição: AlertDialog · AlertDialogTrigger · AlertDialogContent · AlertDialogHeader · AlertDialogTitle · AlertDialogDescription · AlertDialogFooter · AlertDialogAction · AlertDialogCancel · variant (Action/Cancel): as do Button; padrão primary (Action) e outline (Cancel), 44px · regras: inclua sempre AlertDialogCancel (recebe o foco inicial) · Esc fecha · para validar antes de fechar, controle open e use event.preventDefault() no onClick do Action · deprecadas: modal (AlertDialog) · onPointerDownOutside · onInteractOutside (AlertDialogContent): ignoradas desde a 3.1.0; anunciadas na 4.0, saem na 5.0

Uso:

```tsx
    <Button variant="destructive">Excluir</Button>

      <AlertDialogTitle>Excluir requerimento?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>Esta ação não pode ser desfeita.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancelar</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Excluir</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

// Validar antes de fechar (ação assíncrona): controle open e impeça o fechamento automático
<AlertDialog open={aberto} onOpenChange={setAberto}>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    …
    <AlertDialogAction
      variant="destructive"
      onClick={async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); await excluir(); setAberto(false); }}
    >Excluir</AlertDialogAction>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

```tsx
type AlertDialogButtonVariant = VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>["variant"];

export interface AlertDialogActionProps
  extends AlertDialogPrimitive.AlertDialogActionProps {
  /** Variante visual do botão (a mesma do `Button`). Padrão: "primary". */
  variant?: AlertDialogButtonVariant;
}

/**
 * Confirma e fecha o diálogo. Para validar antes de fechar (ex.: chamada
 * assíncrona), controle `open` no `AlertDialog` e chame
 * `event.preventDefault()` no `onClick`.
 */
const AlertDialogAction = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Action>,
  AlertDialogActionProps
>(({ className, variant = "primary", ...props }, ref) => (
  <AlertDialogPrimitive.Action
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size: "md" }), className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertDialogAction.displayName = "AlertDialogAction";

export interface AlertDialogCancelProps
  extends AlertDialogPrimitive.AlertDialogCancelProps {
  /** Variante visual do botão (a mesma do `Button`). Padrão: "outline". */
  variant?: AlertDialogButtonVariant;
}

/** Fecha sem confirmar. Recebe o foco quando o diálogo abre: inclua-o sempre. */
const AlertDialogCancel = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel>,
  AlertDialogCancelProps
>(({ className, variant = "outline", ...props }, ref) => (
  <AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size: "md" }), className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertDialogCancel.displayName = "AlertDialogCancel";

export {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogPortal,
  AlertDialogOverlay,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
};
```

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import * as TogglePrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-toggle";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";

const toggleVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 data-[state=on]:bg-accent data-[state=on]:text-accent-foreground",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-transparent",
        outline:
          "border border-input bg-transparent hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
      },
      size: {
        // AUD-10: `md` (padrão) e `lg` têm 44px. `sm` mantém o visual de 36px,
        // com área clicável estendida a 44×44px por pseudo-elemento.
        sm: "h-9 px-3 relative after:absolute after:left-1/2 after:top-1/2 after:h-full after:min-h-11 after:w-full after:min-w-11 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:-translate-y-1/2",
        md: "h-11 min-w-11 px-3",
        lg: "h-12 min-w-12 px-5",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "md",
    },
  }
);

export interface ToggleProps
  extends React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof TogglePrimitive.Root>,
    VariantProps<typeof toggleVariants> {}

const Toggle = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof TogglePrimitive.Root>,
  ToggleProps
>(({ className, variant, size, ...props }, ref) => (
  <TogglePrimitive.Root
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(toggleVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
    {...props}
  />
));
Toggle.displayName = TogglePrimitive.Root.displayName;

export { Toggle, toggleVariants };
```

### Spinner (`spinner`) — `src/components/spinner.tsx` — slug: spinner

Desc: Indicador de carregamento inline (role=status). Com `decorative`, é só visual (sem role, aria-label nem texto sr-only), para quando outro elemento já anuncia o carregamento; é o que o `Button` com `loading` usa.

Variantes: label: texto anunciado (padrão "Carregando") · decorative: false (padrão, role=status) · true (aria-hidden, sem nome; raiz <span>)

Uso:
```tsx
import { Spinner } from "@semec/ds/react";

<p className="text-muted-foreground">Carregando dados…</p>

<p className="flex items-center gap-2"><Spinner decorative /> Atualizando a lista…</p>
```

Prompt:
```text
Use o componente `Spinner` (Spinner) importado de `@semec/ds/react`; não reimplemente, não copie o código-fonte e não recrie o estilo com outras classes. Indicador de carregamento inline (role=status). Com `decorative`, é só visual (sem role, aria-label nem texto sr-only), para quando outro elemento já anuncia o carregamento; é o que o `Button` com `loading` usa. API e variantes: label: texto anunciado (padrão "Carregando") · decorative: false (padrão, role=status) · true (aria-hidden, sem nome; raiz <span>). Parta do exemplo de uso do componente, com rótulos em PT-BR e tokens do tokens.css (sem hex). Se faltar alguma capacidade, componha com outros componentes do kit ou proponha a mudança por issue no repositório do design system.
```

Fonte:
```tsx
import * as React from "react";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";

export interface SpinnerProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Texto anunciado por leitor de tela. Padrão: "Carregando". */
  label?: string;
  /**
   * Só visual: sem `role="status"`, sem `aria-label` e sem texto `sr-only`
   * (raiz `<span aria-hidden="true">`). Use quando outro elemento já comunica
   * o carregamento, como o `Button` com `loading` (o nome do botão não ganha
   * "Carregando"). Padrão: `false`.
   */
  decorative?: boolean;
}

const spinnerIcon = (
  <svg
    className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-current"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    fill="none"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <circle
      className="opacity-25"
      cx="12"
      cy="12"
      r="10"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="4"
    />
    <path
      className="opacity-75"
      fill="currentColor"
      d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"
    />
  </svg>
);

const Spinner = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SpinnerProps>(
  ({ className, label = "Carregando", decorative = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    if (decorative) {
      // <span>: conteúdo fraseado, válido dentro de <button>.
      return (
        <span
          ref={ref as React.Ref<HTMLSpanElement>}
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn("inline-flex items-center justify-center", className)}
          {...props}
        >
          {spinnerIcon}
        </span>
      );
    }
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="status"
        aria-label={label}
        className={cn("inline-flex items-center justify-center", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {spinnerIcon}
        <span className="sr-only">{label}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
);
Spinner.displayName = "Spinner";

export { Spinner };

```

### Slider (`slider`) — `src/components/slider.tsx` — slug: slider

Desc: Controle deslizante para faixas de valor. Contrato de formulário pela API Radix (`value`/`defaultValue`/`onValueChange` com `number[]`, `name`); `invalid` vira `aria-invalid` nos polegares.

Variantes: contrato: value · defaultValue · onValueChange(number[]) · name · id · invalid · disabled

Uso:
```tsx
import { Slider } from "@semec/ds/react";

// Nome acessível obrigatório: aria-label (ou aria-labelledby) vai para o polegar
<Slider defaultValue={[50]} max={100} step={1} aria-label="Raio de busca em km" />

// Faixa com 2 polegares: anunciados como "Faixa de preço (1 de 2)" e "(2 de 2)"; use getAriaLabel(i) para nomes próprios
<Slider defaultValue={[100, 500]} max={1000} step={10} aria-label="Faixa de preço" />
```

Prompt:
```text
Use o componente `Slider` (Slider) importado de `@semec/ds/react`; não reimplemente, não copie o código-fonte e não recrie o estilo com outras classes. Controle deslizante para faixas de valor. Contrato de formulário pela API Radix (`value`/`defaultValue`/`onValueChange` com `number[]`, `name`); `invalid` vira `aria-invalid` nos polegares. API e variantes: contrato: value · defaultValue · onValueChange(number[]) · name · id · invalid · disabled. Parta do exemplo de uso do componente, com rótulos em PT-BR e tokens do tokens.css (sem hex). Se faltar alguma capacidade, componha com outros componentes do kit ou proponha a mudança por issue no repositório do design system.
```

Fonte:
```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import * as SliderPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-slider";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";
import { useFormFieldControl } from "./form-field";

export interface SliderProps
  extends React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SliderPrimitive.Root> {
  /**
   * Nome acessível de cada polegar (`role="slider"`). Útil com vários polegares,
   * ex.: `(i) => (i === 0 ? "Valor mínimo" : "Valor máximo")`.
   * Sem ela, `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` do Slider vão para os polegares.
   */
  getAriaLabel?: (index: number) => string;
  /** Contrato de formulário (ADR-015): `true` vira `aria-invalid="true"` nos polegares. */
  invalid?: boolean;
}

const Slider = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof SliderPrimitive.Root>,
  SliderProps
>(
  (
    {
      className,
      "aria-label": ariaLabel,
      "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledByProp,
      "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedBy,
      "aria-invalid": ariaInvalid,
      getAriaLabel,
      invalid,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    // Dentro de um FormField: o polegar (span role="slider") não é rotulável por
    // <label for>, então recebe aria-labelledby do rótulo, mais describedby/invalid.
    const field = useFormFieldControl(
      {
        id: props.id,
        "aria-label": ariaLabel ?? (getAriaLabel ? "" : undefined),
        "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledByProp,
        "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedBy,
        "aria-invalid": ariaInvalid,
        invalid,
      },
      { labelable: false }
    );
    const ariaLabelledBy = field["aria-labelledby"] ?? ariaLabelledByProp;
    // Um polegar por valor (range com 2 valores = 2 polegares).
    const count = Math.max((props.value ?? props.defaultValue ?? [0]).length, 1);

    const thumbLabel = (index: number) => {
      if (getAriaLabel) return getAriaLabel(index);
      if (ariaLabelledBy || !ariaLabel) return undefined;
      return count > 1 ? `${ariaLabel} (${index + 1} de ${count})` : ariaLabel;
    };

    return (
      <SliderPrimitive.Root
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex w-full touch-none select-none items-center",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
        id={field.id ?? props.id}
      >
        <SliderPrimitive.Track className="relative h-2 w-full grow overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-secondary">
          <SliderPrimitive.Range className="absolute h-full bg-primary" />
        </SliderPrimitive.Track>
        {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => (
          <SliderPrimitive.Thumb
            key={index}
            aria-label={thumbLabel(index)}
            aria-labelledby={getAriaLabel ? undefined : ariaLabelledBy}
            aria-describedby={field["aria-describedby"] ?? ariaDescribedBy}
            aria-invalid={field["aria-invalid"] ?? ariaInvalid}
            className="relative block h-5 w-5 rounded-full after:absolute after:-inset-3 after:content-[''] after:rounded-full border-2 border-primary bg-background shadow-elevation-1 transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-[invalid=true]:border-destructive"
          />
        ))}
      </SliderPrimitive.Root>
    );
  }
);
Slider.displayName = SliderPrimitive.Root.displayName;

export { Slider };

```

---

### Input OTP (`input-otp`) — `src/components/input-otp.tsx` — slug: input-otp

Desc: Campo de código OTP com foco automático entre dígitos.

Uso:
```tsx

<InputOTP name="codigo" value={code} onValueChange={setCode} maxLength={6}>
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
</InputOTP>
```

Prompt:
```text
Use o componente `InputOTP` (Input OTP) importado de `@semec/ds/react`; não reimplemente, não copie o código-fonte e não recrie o estilo com outras classes. Campo de código OTP com foco automático entre dígitos. API e variantes: composição: InputOTP · InputOTPGroup · InputOTPSlot · InputOTPSeparator · props: value · defaultValue · onValueChange · name (input oculto) · form · id · invalid · required · maxLength · disabled · labels (group · slot(index, total)) · removidas na 4.0: onChange(value) → use onValueChange. Parta do exemplo de uso do componente, com rótulos em PT-BR e tokens do tokens.css (sem hex). Se faltar alguma capacidade, componha com outros componentes do kit ou proponha a mudança por issue no repositório do design system.
```

Fonte:
```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";
import { useFormField, useFormFieldControl } from "./form-field";

interface InputOTPContextValue {
  slots: string[];
  handleSlotChange: (index: number, value: string) => void;
  handleKeyDown: (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  handlePaste: (index: number, e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  registerSlot: (index: number, el: HTMLInputElement | null) => void;
  maxLength: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  invalid?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  labels: InputOTPLabels;
}

export interface InputOTPLabels {
  /** Nome do grupo quando não há `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`. Padrão: "Código de verificação". */
  group: string;
  /** Nome de cada dígito. Padrão: `Dígito ${index + 1} de ${total}`. */
  slot: (index: number, total: number) => string;
}

const defaultLabels: InputOTPLabels = {
  group: "Código de verificação",
  slot: (index, total) => `Dígito ${index + 1} de ${total}`,
};

const InputOTPContext = React.createContext<InputOTPContextValue | null>(null);

function useInputOTP() {
  const ctx = React.useContext(InputOTPContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("InputOTP compound components must be used within <InputOTP>");
  return ctx;
}

export interface InputOTPProps
  extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange" | "defaultValue"> {
  /** Valor controlado. Sem ele, o componente guarda o estado sozinho. */
  value?: string;
  /**
   * Valor inicial (modo não controlado). Aceita o tipo herdado de
   * `HTMLAttributes` (3.1.0) e normaliza para string.
   */
  defaultValue?: string | number | readonly string[];
  /**
   * Recebe os dígitos preenchidos concatenados, sem lacunas: com "1" no slot 1
   * e "6" no slot 6, o valor emitido é "16" (a tela mantém as posições).
   * Contrato de formulário (ADR-015).
   */
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /**
   * Removido na 4.0 (AUD-35): use `onValueChange`. O InputOTP não tem
   * `onChange` próprio nem repassa `onChange` ao DOM; o tipo recusa a prop
   * e, em JavaScript, um handler passado aqui é descartado e nunca é chamado.
   */
  onChange?: never;
  /** Gera um `<input type="hidden" name>` com o código, para envio em `<form>`. */
  name?: string;
  /** `id` do `<form>` do input oculto, quando o InputOTP fica fora dele. */
  form?: string;
  /** Vira `aria-required` em cada dígito (o grupo não aceita `aria-required`). */
  required?: boolean;
  /** `true` vira `aria-invalid="true"` e o estilo de erro. Dentro de FormField, vence o estado dele. */
  invalid?: boolean;
  maxLength?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Textos fixos (PT-BR por padrão). */
  labels?: Partial<InputOTPLabels>;
}

// Array de tamanho fixo: cada posição é um slot, mesmo vazio.
// Evita que "1" no slot 1 e "6" no slot 6 virem "16" ao reconstruir o valor.
const toSlots = (str: string, length: number) =>
  Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => str[i] ?? "");

const InputOTP = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, InputOTPProps>(
  (
    {
      className,
      value,
      defaultValue,
      onChange: _removedOnChange,
      onValueChange,
      name,
      form,
      required,
      invalid: invalidProp,
      maxLength = 6,
      disabled,
      labels,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const isControlled = value !== undefined;
    const slotsRef = React.useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);
    const [internalSlots, setSlots] = React.useState<string[]>(() =>
      toSlots(
        value ??
          (Array.isArray(defaultValue)
            ? defaultValue.join("")
            : defaultValue !== undefined
              ? String(defaultValue)
              : ""),
        maxLength
      )
    );

    // Modo controlado: a tela reflete sempre o `value` do pai. O array interno
    // só é usado enquanto o pai aceitar o que foi emitido (value === join), o
    // que preserva a posição de dígitos digitados fora de ordem na tela.
    // Se o pai recusar, truncar ou resetar o valor, vale o `value`.
    const internalValue = internalSlots.join("");
    const slots =
      isControlled && value !== internalValue
        ? toSlots(value, maxLength)
        : internalSlots.length === maxLength
          ? internalSlots
          : toSlots(internalValue, maxLength);

    const focusSlot = React.useCallback((index: number) => {
      const el = slotsRef.current[index];
      el?.focus();
      el?.select();
    }, []);

    const commit = React.useCallback(
      (next: string[]) => {
        setSlots(next);
        onValueChange?.(next.join(""));
      },
      [onValueChange]
    );

    const fillFrom = React.useCallback(
      (start: number, digits: string) => {
        const next = [...slots];
        const chars = digits.slice(0, maxLength - start).split("");
        chars.forEach((char, i) => {
          next[start + i] = char;
        });
        commit(next);
        focusSlot(Math.min(start + chars.length, maxLength - 1));
      },
      [slots, maxLength, commit, focusSlot]
    );

    const handleSlotChange = React.useCallback(
      (index: number, raw: string) => {
        if (disabled) return;
        const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, "");
        if (digits.length > 1) {
          // Dígito digitado sobre um slot já preenchido sem seleção: fica o novo.
          const current = slots[index];
          if (digits.length === 2 && current && digits.includes(current)) {
            fillFrom(index, digits.replace(current, ""));
            return;
          }
          // Autopreenchimento (autocomplete="one-time-code"): distribui pelos slots.
          fillFrom(digits.length >= maxLength ? 0 : index, digits);
          return;
        }
        const next = [...slots];
        next[index] = digits;
        commit(next);
        if (digits && index < maxLength - 1) focusSlot(index + 1);
      },
      [disabled, slots, maxLength, commit, fillFrom, focusSlot]
    );

    const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
      (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (disabled) return;
        if (e.key === "Backspace") {
          e.preventDefault();
          const next = [...slots];
          if (next[index]) {
            next[index] = "";
            commit(next);
          } else if (index > 0) {
            next[index - 1] = "";
            commit(next);
            focusSlot(index - 1);
          }
        } else if (e.key === "Delete") {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (slots[index]) {
            const next = [...slots];
            next[index] = "";
            commit(next);
          }
        } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && index > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          focusSlot(index - 1);
        } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && index < maxLength - 1) {
          e.preventDefault();
          focusSlot(index + 1);
        }
      },
      [disabled, slots, maxLength, commit, focusSlot]
    );

    const handlePaste = React.useCallback(
      (index: number, e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (disabled) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const pasted = e.clipboardData.getData("text").replace(/\D/g, "");
        if (!pasted) return;
        // Código completo começa no primeiro slot; trecho parcial, no slot focado.
        fillFrom(pasted.length >= maxLength ? 0 : index, pasted);
      },
      [disabled, maxLength, fillFrom]
    );

    const registerSlot = React.useCallback((index: number, el: HTMLInputElement | null) => {
      slotsRef.current[index] = el;
    }, []);

    // Dentro de um FormField: o grupo (div) não é rotulável por <label for>,
    // então recebe aria-labelledby do rótulo, mais describedby/invalid.
    const field = useFormFieldControl({ ...props, invalid: invalidProp }, { labelable: false });
    const fieldCtx = useFormField();
    const text = { ...defaultLabels, ...labels };
    const invalid = field["aria-invalid"] ?? props["aria-invalid"];

    const contextValue: InputOTPContextValue = {
      slots,
      handleSlotChange,
      handleKeyDown,
      handlePaste,
      registerSlot,
      maxLength,
      disabled,
      invalid: invalid === true || invalid === "true",
      required: required ?? Boolean(fieldCtx?.required),
      labels: text,
    };

    // Grupo rotulado: o consumidor pode passar aria-label/aria-labelledby.
    const hasLabel =
      props["aria-label"] !== undefined ||
      (field["aria-labelledby"] ?? props["aria-labelledby"]) !== undefined;

    return (
      <InputOTPContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
        <div
          ref={ref}
          role="group"
          aria-label={hasLabel ? undefined : text.group}
          className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", className)}
          {...props}
          {...field}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
        {name ? (
          <input type="hidden" name={name} value={slots.join("")} form={form} />
        ) : null}
      </InputOTPContext.Provider>
    );
  }
);
InputOTP.displayName = "InputOTP";

const InputOTPGroup = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("flex items-center gap-1", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
InputOTPGroup.displayName = "InputOTPGroup";

export interface InputOTPSlotProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  index: number;
}

const InputOTPSlot = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, InputOTPSlotProps>(
  ({ className, index, ...props }, ref) => {
    const {
      slots,
      handleSlotChange,
      handleKeyDown,
      handlePaste,
      registerSlot,
      maxLength,
      disabled,
      invalid,
      required,
      labels,
    } = useInputOTP();
    const value = slots[index] || "";
    const inputRef = React.useCallback(
      (el: HTMLInputElement | null) => registerSlot(index, el),
      [registerSlot, index]
    );

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-input bg-background text-lg font-medium text-foreground shadow-elevation-1 transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-ring focus-within:ring-offset-2 focus-within:ring-offset-background",
          disabled && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed",
          invalid && "border-destructive",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          inputMode="numeric"
          autoComplete={index === 0 ? "one-time-code" : "off"}
          value={value}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => handleSlotChange(index, e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(index, e)}
          onPaste={(e) => handlePaste(index, e)}
          onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()}
          className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded-[inherit] border-0 bg-transparent text-center text-lg font-medium text-foreground caret-transparent outline-none"
          aria-label={labels.slot(index, maxLength)}
          aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
          aria-required={required || undefined}
        />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none">
          {value || ""}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }
);
InputOTPSlot.displayName = "InputOTPSlot";

const InputOTPSeparator = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    role="separator"
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn("px-1 text-lg font-medium text-muted-foreground", className)}
    {...props}
  >
    –
  </div>
));
InputOTPSeparator.displayName = "InputOTPSeparator";

export { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, InputOTPSeparator };

```

### Calendário (`calendar`) — `src/components/calendar.tsx` — slug: calendario

Desc: Calendário mensal no padrão APG de grade de datas: uma parada de Tab na grade, setas, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown e nomes completos em PT-BR. Células e botões de 44px.

Variantes: props: value · onValueChange · min · max (AAAA-MM-DD, data local) · disabled · labels?: Partial<{ previousMonth, nextMonth }> · removidas na 4.0: onChange(date) → use onValueChange · a11y: role=grid rotulado pelo mês (aria-live=polite) · roving tabindex · aria-selected · aria-current=date no dia de hoje · aria-disabled fora de min/max · nome "14 de outubro de 2026" · teclado: ←/→ dia · ↑/↓ semana · Home/End início/fim da semana · PageUp/PageDown mês · Shift+PageUp/PageDown ano · Enter/Espaço seleciona

Uso:
```tsx
import { Calendar } from "@semec/ds/react";

<Calendar value={data} onValueChange={setData} />

<Calendar value={data} onValueChange={setData} min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31" />
```

Prompt:
```text
Use o componente `Calendar` (Calendário) importado de `@semec/ds/react`; não reimplemente, não copie o código-fonte e não recrie o estilo com outras classes. Calendário mensal no padrão APG de grade de datas: uma parada de Tab na grade, setas, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown e nomes completos em PT-BR. Células e botões de 44px. API e variantes: props: value · onValueChange · min · max (AAAA-MM-DD, data local) · disabled · labels?: Partial<{ previousMonth, nextMonth }> · removidas na 4.0: onChange(date) → use onValueChange · a11y: role=grid rotulado pelo mês (aria-live=polite) · roving tabindex · aria-selected · aria-current=date no dia de hoje · aria-disabled fora de min/max · nome "14 de outubro de 2026" · teclado: ←/→ dia · ↑/↓ semana · Home/End início/fim da semana · PageUp/PageDown mês · Shift+PageUp/PageDown ano · Enter/Espaço seleciona. Parta do exemplo de uso do componente, com rótulos em PT-BR e tokens do tokens.css (sem hex). Se faltar alguma capacidade, componha com outros componentes do kit ou proponha a mudança por issue no repositório do design system.
```

Fonte:
```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";

const LOCALE = "pt-BR";

const WEEKDAYS = [
  { short: "Dom", long: "domingo" },
  { short: "Seg", long: "segunda-feira" },
  { short: "Ter", long: "terça-feira" },
  { short: "Qua", long: "quarta-feira" },
  { short: "Qui", long: "quinta-feira" },
  { short: "Sex", long: "sexta-feira" },
  { short: "Sáb", long: "sábado" },
];

const dayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, {
  day: "numeric",
  month: "long",
  year: "numeric",
});
const monthFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, {
  month: "long",
  year: "numeric",
});

/** Textos anunciados pelo Calendar. Todos têm padrão em PT-BR. */
export interface CalendarLabels {
  /** Nome do botão que volta um mês. Padrão: "Mês anterior". */
  previousMonth: string;
  /** Nome do botão que avança um mês. Padrão: "Próximo mês". */
  nextMonth: string;
}

const DEFAULT_LABELS: CalendarLabels = {
  previousMonth: "Mês anterior",
  nextMonth: "Próximo mês",
};

export interface CalendarProps
  extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange"> {
  value?: Date | null;
  /** Recebe a data escolhida (contrato de formulário, ADR-015). */
  onValueChange?: (date: Date) => void;
  /**
   * Removido na 4.0 (AUD-35): use `onValueChange`. O Calendar não tem
   * `onChange` próprio nem repassa `onChange` ao DOM; o tipo recusa a prop
   * e, em JavaScript, um handler passado aqui é descartado e nunca é chamado.
   */
  onChange?: never;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Data mínima selecionável (`AAAA-MM-DD`). */
  min?: string;
  /** Data máxima selecionável (`AAAA-MM-DD`). */
  max?: string;
  /** Sobrescreve os textos anunciados (AUD-31). */
  labels?: Partial<CalendarLabels>;
}

/** Lê `AAAA-MM-DD` como data local (o `new Date("AAAA-MM-DD")` usa UTC e erra um dia no Brasil). */
function parseDateString(input?: string): Date | undefined {
  if (!input) return undefined;
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(input);
  if (m) return new Date(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]));
  const d = new Date(input);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return undefined;
  return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
}

function startOfDay(d: Date) {
  return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
}

function isSameDay(a?: Date | null, b?: Date | null) {
  return (
    !!a &&
    !!b &&
    a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() &&
    a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() &&
    a.getDate() === b.getDate()
  );
}

function addDays(d: Date, n: number) {
  return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate() + n);
}

/** Soma meses mantendo o dia, limitado ao último dia do mês de destino. */
function addMonths(d: Date, n: number) {
  const target = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + n, 1);
  const last = new Date(target.getFullYear(), target.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  return new Date(target.getFullYear(), target.getMonth(), Math.min(d.getDate(), last));
}

function capitalize(s: string) {
  return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
}

const navButtonClass =
  "inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-foreground transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50";

/**
 * Calendário mensal no padrão APG "date picker grid": uma única parada de
 * `Tab` na grade (roving tabindex), setas movem por dia/semana, `Home`/`End`
 * vão ao início/fim da semana, `PageUp`/`PageDown` trocam o mês
 * (`Shift` + `PageUp`/`PageDown` trocam o ano) e `Enter`/`Espaço` selecionam.
 */
const Calendar = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CalendarProps>(
  ({ className, value, onChange: _removedOnChange, onValueChange, disabled, min, max, labels, ...props }, ref) => {
    const text = { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labels };
    const headingId = React.useId();
    const today = startOfDay(new Date());

    const minDate = parseDateString(min);
    const maxDate = parseDateString(max);

    const [focusedDate, setFocusedDate] = React.useState<Date>(() =>
      value ? startOfDay(value) : today
    );
    const gridRef = React.useRef<HTMLTableElement>(null);
    const shouldFocusRef = React.useRef(false);

    // Valor controlado de fora: leva a grade até a data escolhida.
    const valueKey = value ? startOfDay(value).getTime() : null;
    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (valueKey !== null) setFocusedDate(new Date(valueKey));
    }, [valueKey]);

    const year = focusedDate.getFullYear();
    const month = focusedDate.getMonth();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!shouldFocusRef.current) return;
      shouldFocusRef.current = false;
      const cell = gridRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[tabindex="0"]');
      cell?.focus();
    }, [focusedDate]);

    const isDisabled = (date: Date) => {
      if (disabled) return true;
      if (minDate && date < minDate) return true;
      if (maxDate && date > maxDate) return true;
      return false;
    };

    const select = (date: Date) => {
      if (isDisabled(date)) return;
      onValueChange?.(date);
    };

    const moveFocus = (date: Date) => {
      shouldFocusRef.current = true;
      setFocusedDate(date);
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTableElement>) => {
      let next: Date | null = null;
      switch (event.key) {
        case "ArrowLeft":
          next = addDays(focusedDate, -1);
          break;
        case "ArrowRight":
          next = addDays(focusedDate, 1);
          break;
        case "ArrowUp":
          next = addDays(focusedDate, -7);
          break;
        case "ArrowDown":
          next = addDays(focusedDate, 7);
          break;
        case "Home":
          next = addDays(focusedDate, -focusedDate.getDay());
          break;
        case "End":
          next = addDays(focusedDate, 6 - focusedDate.getDay());
          break;
        case "PageUp":
          next = addMonths(focusedDate, event.shiftKey ? -12 : -1);
          break;
        case "PageDown":
          next = addMonths(focusedDate, event.shiftKey ? 12 : 1);
          break;
        case "Enter":
        case " ":
          event.preventDefault();
          select(focusedDate);
          return;
        default:
          return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
      moveFocus(next);
    };

    const cells: (Date | null)[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < firstDay; i++) cells.push(null);
    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) cells.push(new Date(year, month, d));
    while (cells.length % 7 !== 0) cells.push(null);
    const weeks: (Date | null)[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i += 7) weeks.push(cells.slice(i, i + 7));

    return (
      <div ref={ref} className={cn("p-3", className)} {...props}>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFocusedDate(addMonths(focusedDate, -1))}
            className={navButtonClass}
            aria-label={text.previousMonth}
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
          <div
            id={headingId}
            aria-live="polite"
            aria-atomic="true"
            className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground"
          >
            {capitalize(monthFormatter.format(new Date(year, month, 1)))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFocusedDate(addMonths(focusedDate, 1))}
            className={navButtonClass}
            aria-label={text.nextMonth}
          >
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <table
          ref={gridRef}
          role="grid"
          aria-labelledby={headingId}
          aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          className="border-separate border-spacing-0"
        >
          <thead>
            <tr>
              {WEEKDAYS.map((day) => (
                <th
                  key={day.short}
                  scope="col"
                  abbr={day.long}
                  className="h-8 w-11 p-0 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  {day.short}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {weeks.map((week, w) => (
              <tr key={w}>
                {week.map((date, i) => {
                  if (!date) return <td key={`empty-${w}-${i}`} className="p-0" />;
                  const selected = isSameDay(date, value);
                  const isToday = isSameDay(date, today);
                  const off = isDisabled(date);
                  const focusable = isSameDay(date, focusedDate);
                  return (
                    <td
                      key={date.getDate()}
                      // Explícito: nem toda árvore de acessibilidade deriva gridcell do
                      // <td> dentro de role="grid", e aria-selected só vale em gridcell.
                      role="gridcell"
                      tabIndex={focusable ? 0 : -1}
                      aria-selected={selected}
                      aria-current={isToday ? "date" : undefined}
                      aria-disabled={off || undefined}
                      aria-label={dayFormatter.format(date)}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setFocusedDate(date);
                        select(date);
                      }}
                      className={cn(
                        "h-11 w-11 cursor-pointer select-none rounded-md p-0 text-center align-middle text-sm transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2",
                        selected
                          ? "bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground"
                          : isToday
                            ? "bg-accent font-semibold text-accent-foreground underline underline-offset-4"
                            : "text-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
                        off && "cursor-default opacity-50 hover:bg-transparent"
                      )}
                    >
                      {date.getDate()}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    );
  }
);
Calendar.displayName = "Calendar";

export { Calendar };

```

```tsx
  "fixed z-50 gap-4 overflow-y-auto bg-card p-6 shadow-elevation-3 duration-base ease-standard data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0",
```

### Sheet (`sheet`) — `src/components/sheet.tsx` — slug: sheet

Desc: Painel lateral modal com overlay. Variantes left/right/top/bottom.

```tsx
  <SheetTrigger asChild><Button variant="outline">Abrir filtros</Button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="left">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Filtros</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Refine sua busca.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>

// Controlado SEM SheetTrigger (ex.: aberto por um item de tabela): o Radix
// não sabe para onde devolver o foco. Guarde a origem e devolva em onCloseAutoFocus.
function FiltrosControlados() {
  const [aberto, setAberto] = React.useState(false);
  const origemRef = React.useRef(null);
  return (
    <>
      <Button ref={origemRef} onClick={() => setAberto(true)}>Filtros</Button>
      <Sheet open={aberto} onOpenChange={setAberto}>
        <SheetContent
          closeLabel="Fechar filtros"
          onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); origemRef.current?.focus(); }}
        >
          <SheetHeader><SheetTitle>Filtros</SheetTitle></SheetHeader>
          {/* conteúdo longo rola dentro do painel (overflow-y-auto) */}
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
          "inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-h-[85dvh] border-t border-border data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-bottom data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-bottom",
        left: "inset-y-0 left-0 h-full w-3/4 border-r border-border data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-left data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-left sm:max-w-sm",
        right:
          "inset-y-0 right-0 h-full w-3/4 border-l border-border data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-right sm:max-w-sm",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      side: "right",
    },
  }
);

export interface SheetContentProps
  extends React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>,
    VariantProps<typeof sheetVariants> {
  /** Nome acessível do botão X de fechar. Padrão: "Fechar". */
  closeLabel?: string;
}

const SheetContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>,
  SheetContentProps
>(({ side = "right", className, children, closeLabel = "Fechar", ...props }, ref) => (
  <SheetPortal>
    <SheetOverlay />
    <DialogPrimitive.Content
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(sheetVariants({ side }), className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <DialogPrimitive.Close className="absolute right-3 top-3 inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none">
        <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="sr-only">{closeLabel}</span>
      </DialogPrimitive.Close>
    </DialogPrimitive.Content>
  </SheetPortal>
));
SheetContent.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Content.displayName;

const SheetHeader = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
  <div
    className={cn("flex flex-col space-y-2 pr-8 text-left", className)}
    {...props}
  />
);
SheetHeader.displayName = "SheetHeader";

const SheetFooter = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
  <div
    className={cn("flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end", className)}
    {...props}
  />
);
SheetFooter.displayName = "SheetFooter";

const SheetTitle = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Title
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("text-lg font-semibold text-foreground", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
SheetTitle.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Title.displayName;

const SheetDescription = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Description
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
SheetDescription.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Description.displayName;

export {
  Sheet,
  SheetPortal,
  SheetOverlay,
  SheetTrigger,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetDescription,
```

```text
Use o componente `DataTable` (Tabela de dados) importado de `@semec/ds/react`; não reimplemente, não copie o código-fonte e não recrie o estilo com outras classes. Tabela com ordenação, paginação e estados vazios. API e variantes: props: columns · data · sortKey · sortDir · onSort · page · pageCount · onPageChange · onRowClick · emptyMessage · caption · labels (sortBy · pageOf · previous · next) · a11y: ordenação por botão com aria-sort · linha focável e ativável por Enter/Espaço quando há onRowClick · paginação com alvos de 44px. Parta do exemplo de uso do componente, com rótulos em PT-BR e tokens do tokens.css (sem hex). Se faltar alguma capacidade, componha com outros componentes do kit ou proponha a mudança por issue no repositório do design system.
```

Fonte:
```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowUpDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "../lib/utils";

type SortDirection = "asc" | "desc" | null;

export interface DataTableLabels {
  /** Rótulo do botão de ordenação. Padrão: `Ordenar por ${header}`. */
  sortBy: (header: string) => string;
  /** Texto da paginação. Padrão: `Página ${page} de ${pageCount}`. */
  pageOf: (page: number, pageCount: number) => string;
  /** Padrão: "Anterior". */
  previous: string;
  /** Padrão: "Próximo". */
  next: string;
}

const defaultDataTableLabels: DataTableLabels = {
  sortBy: (header) => `Ordenar por ${header}`,
  pageOf: (page, pageCount) => `Página ${page} de ${pageCount}`,
  previous: "Anterior",
  next: "Próximo",
};

interface Column<T> {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  sortable?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  render?: (row: T, index: number) => React.ReactNode;
}

interface DataTableProps<T> extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  columns: Column<T>[];
  data: T[];
  sortKey?: string | null;
  sortDir?: SortDirection;
  onSort?: (key: string) => void;
  page?: number;
  pageCount?: number;
  onPageChange?: (page: number) => void;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  rowKey?: (row: T, index: number) => string | number;
  /**
   * Ativação da linha inteira. A linha fica focável (Tab) e responde a
   * Enter/Espaço, além do clique. Para várias ações por linha, prefira uma
   * coluna de ações com botões (`render`) — ver manifest/usage.
   */
  onRowClick?: (row: T, index: number) => void;
  caption?: string;
  /** Textos embutidos (PT-BR por padrão), sobrescrevíveis um a um. */
  labels?: Partial<DataTableLabels>;
}

function DataTableInner<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  {
    columns,
    data,
    sortKey,
    sortDir,
    onSort,
    page,
    pageCount,
    onPageChange,
    emptyMessage = "Nenhum registro encontrado.",
    rowKey,
    onRowClick,
    caption,
    labels: labelsProp,
    className,
    ...props
  }: DataTableProps<T>,
  _ref: React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>
) {
  const labels = { ...defaultDataTableLabels, ...labelsProp };

  const handleSort = (key: string) => {
    onSort?.(key);
  };

  const getSortIcon = (key: string) => {
    if (sortKey !== key || !sortDir)
      return <ArrowUpDown className="h-3 w-3 opacity-50" aria-hidden="true" />;
    if (sortDir === "asc") return <ArrowUp className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true" />;
    return <ArrowDown className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true" />;
  };

  // Enter/Espaço ativam a linha só quando o foco está nela mesma, para não
  // sequestrar teclas de botões/links dentro das células.
  const handleRowKeyDown = (
    event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTableRowElement>,
    row: T,
    index: number
  ) => {
    if (!onRowClick || event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
    if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
      event.preventDefault();
      onRowClick(row, index);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={_ref} className={cn("w-full", className)} {...props}>
      <div className="relative w-full overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border">
        <table className="w-full caption-bottom text-sm">
          {caption && (
            <caption className="mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {caption}
            </caption>
          )}
          <thead className="border-b border-border bg-muted/50">
            <tr>
              {columns.map((col) => (
                <th
                  key={col.key}
                  scope="col"
                  aria-sort={
                    col.sortable
                      ? sortKey === col.key && sortDir
                        ? sortDir === "asc"
                          ? "ascending"
                          : "descending"
                        : "none"
                      : undefined
                  }
                  className={cn(
                    "h-11 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-muted-foreground [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0",
                    col.sortable && "select-none hover:text-foreground",
                    col.className
                  )}
                >
                  {col.sortable ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSort(col.key)}
                      aria-label={labels.sortBy(col.header)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-sm cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
                    >
                      {col.header}
                      {getSortIcon(col.key)}
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">{col.header}</div>
                  )}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {data.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td
                  colSpan={columns.length}
                  className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  {emptyMessage}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              data.map((row, index) => (
                <tr
                  key={rowKey ? rowKey(row, index) : index}
                  className={cn(
                    "border-b border-border transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-muted/50 data-[state=selected]:bg-muted",
                    onRowClick &&
                      "cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
                  )}
                  tabIndex={onRowClick ? 0 : undefined}
                  onClick={onRowClick ? () => onRowClick(row, index) : undefined}
                  onKeyDown={
                    onRowClick
                      ? (event) => handleRowKeyDown(event, row, index)
                      : undefined
                  }
                >
                  {columns.map((col) => (
                    <td
                      key={col.key}
                      className={cn(
                        "p-4 align-middle [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0",
                        col.className
                      )}
                    >
                      {col.render
                        ? col.render(row, index)
                        : String(row[col.key] ?? "")}
                    </td>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {page !== undefined && pageCount !== undefined && pageCount > 1 && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-4">
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {labels.pageOf(page, pageCount)}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onPageChange?.(page - 1)}
              disabled={page <= 1}
              className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm font-medium text-foreground transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              {labels.previous}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onPageChange?.(page + 1)}
              disabled={page >= pageCount}
              className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm font-medium text-foreground transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
            >
              {labels.next}
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const DataTable = React.forwardRef(DataTableInner) as <
  T extends Record<string, unknown>
>(
  props: DataTableProps<T> & { ref?: React.Ref<HTMLDivElement> }
) => React.ReactElement;

export { DataTable };
export type { Column, DataTableProps, SortDirection };

```

```tsx
/**

 * O tipo do ref é `HTMLElement` para aceitar refs antigos de `div`.

  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
    <ol
      ref={ref as React.Ref<HTMLOListElement>}

      ref={ref as React.Ref<HTMLLIElement>}
      className={cn("group/timeline-item relative flex gap-4", className)}

  HTMLDivElement,

export interface TimelineDotProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  variant?: TimelineDotVariant;
  /**
   * Status do item em texto para leitor de tela (ex.: "Concluído", "Pendente").
   * A cor do ponto sozinha não comunica o status (WCAG 1.4.1).
   */
  srLabel?: string;
}

const TimelineDot = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TimelineDotProps>(
  ({ className, variant = "default", srLabel, children, ...props }, ref) => (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "z-10 mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-background",
        variant === "default" && "bg-primary",
        variant === "success" && "bg-success",
        variant === "warning" && "bg-warning",
        variant === "destructive" && "bg-destructive",
        variant === "info" && "bg-info",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {srLabel ? <span className="sr-only">{srLabel}</span> : null}
      {children}
    </div>
  )
);

  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (

    ref={ref}
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn("my-1 min-h-6 w-0.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-border-strong", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
TimelineConnector.displayName = "TimelineConnector";

  HTMLDivElement,

>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (

    ref={ref}
    className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1 pb-8 pt-0 group-last/timeline-item:pb-0", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
TimelineContent.displayName = "TimelineContent";

export interface TimelineTitleProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Elemento do título. Padrão: `div` (comportamento anterior). */
  as?: HeadingTag;
}

const TimelineTitle = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TimelineTitleProps>(

      ref={ref}
      className={cn("text-sm font-medium text-foreground leading-none mb-1", className)}
      {...props}
    />

    ref={ref}

    {...props}
  />

export {

  TimelineSeparator,

};
```
